root: ^Mewow, where did you get all that food...can I have some?
^They come from above. From my gods. Nom Nom.
^They fall from above and right down to this spot. It’s their gift to me.
^Yeah I don’t think those are from gods...
^What are you talking about, of course they are!
^Maybe your gods meant for me to have some too...
^No. Sorry. These are meant just for me.
^Greedy guts. I’d kill for some seafood. I have to eat scraps from behind the bins.
^Wait...you have never been given a gift from the sky?
^No. There is this girl, she sometimes feeds me nice things...but she’s not a god.
^Do her gifts come from above? Nom.
^I mean technically...she is much taller than me.
^Don’t be stupid. She’s just a girl.
^By the way, do you know where can I find god?
^The real one, always willing help the people and fishes.
^You’ll make me miss my next gift!!
